about: Peter Parker Smirk is a still of Tobey Maguire's Peter Parker in the black symbiote suit, eyes darting sideways and lips pressed into a small, sly smile. It comes from the part of Spider-Man 3 where the suit makes Peter cocky and vain, so the grin carries a hint of smug, slightly corrupted confidence. As a reaction image it captures quiet self-satisfaction: getting away with something, being secretly right, or enjoying a guilty pleasure while trying to look cool about it. It works for small, private wins much more than for big triumphs.
origin: The frame is from Sam Raimi's Spider-Man 3 (2007). The emo phase of Peter Parker became a big part of the "Bully Maguire" meme wave years later, and this smirk is one of its reaction stills.
usage:
Use the top box for a "when" setup and the bottom box for the win, or the reason Peter looks so pleased. The smile should feel earned in a petty way.

Ideal for: your hack getting approved, knowing a spoiler nobody else does, finding the last of the snacks, or getting a compliment on a meal that took 5 minutes. It also suits a villain-origin vibe, like the moment you decide to stop being nice in the group chat.
